title: S9b: Crash mid-reseed is total local loss

description: The reseed sequence is export -> wipe -> import with NO JOURNAL and a temp-dir bundle; a crash at any point after the wipe leaves nothing to recover from. One of three distinct failure modes split from the original S9 finding (S9a/S9b/S9c). Severity: High. Wave/Plan: Wave 2, plan 2b backup-restore-correctness. Sweep: sync machinery.
